label: МРЗ 660 евро от 1 януари 2027 г. — с 6,4% повече
text: The projected minimum wage is €660 a month from 1 Jan 2027 (€680 in 2028, €710 in 2029), and the minimum insured income by economic activity and skill group is uprated by the same 6.4%; the minimum insured income for self-insured persons is set at the same €660. Budget-sector personnel costs rise 5%, teachers +7.5% (€170.5m), while the „Сигурност“ sector is excluded entirely — the single most contested line in the bill.
